title: Weird bathrooms??
content: Why the HELL are bathrooms always so disgusting or big in dreams? Like one time I had a dream I was in one of the school bathrooms, and it was like a massive bathrooms, a bunch of stalls in such weird positioning, like imagine a maze with all the twist and turns, but it's like weirdly positioned bathroom stalls. Then another time it was just a dark bathroom with like yellow walls and a dark light with a single toilet. Is there any explanation to this or is it just like some weird thing nobody can explain?
